acceptedLearning: metric physical archetypes must carry real dimensions, mass and collision margins
one visible fill input must derive geometry, canonical mass and center of mass
the visible lathed bottle body must also be the convex collision-hull source
post-release and final poses belong exclusively to Blender Bullet
event frame and native shutter are selected from measured evaluated motion

old-schema visual detail geometry must remain exact because it can affect camera-derived measurements

next: Publish the validated source by ordinary fast-forward, then use these learned constraints as the physical-archetype foundation for the retained robot capstone without hand-placing outcomes.
